fieldValues.title: Runs differ and nobody can tell
fieldValues.statement: The same process run twice, or by another model, may produce a different document, and nothing measures or shows the difference. Re-running a stage has no defined effect on what the first run made or what later stages built on it, so quality claims rest on one reading of one run.
source_ref: srs-programme source-documents/governance-minutes-2026-11-27/srs-minutes-project.md, Risks: one model, one run, no variance measured
